chunks: Have they taken others beside Him as protectors? It is God who protects; it is He who gives life to the dead, for He has power over everything.

key_terms.أَوْلِيَاءَ: Plural of Wali, meaning protectors, guardians, or allies
key_terms.الْوَلِيُّ: The Guardian, The Protector, The Sovereign
key_terms.يُحْيِي الْمَوْتَى: He gives life to the dead

ai.seo_question: Who is the true Wali (Protector/Guardian) according to Surah Ash-Shura?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often cited to establish Allah as the ultimate Wali (Guardian/Protector), contrasting divine authority with the false intercessors (Awliya') sought by polytheists. It underscores the concept of Tawhid al-Ulama (Unity of Guardianship), where God’s power to resurrect and His omnipotence serve as proof of His exclusive right to be followed, a theme central to understanding the role of the Ahl al-Bayt as His appointed representatives.
